  "overall_experience": "The manager found Freshsales to be generally easy to use and appreciated its intuitive deal flow for managing sales opportunities within their marketing and advertising company. While the platform offered a consolidated approach to sales, they were somewhat frustrated by the limited robust reporting capabilities, which hindered their ability to perform comprehensive sales analysis. Additionally, they noted the absence of automatic reminders and some advanced features, alongside a less-than-ideal customer support experience."
